alternatives.note: GPIO14/15 is UART0: enable it (it's off by default). Don't rely on enable_uart=1 alone: with no cable on the debug header, Raspberry Pi 5 then routes kernel debug output to GPIO 14 and 15 (interfaces.adoc, Prerequisite information), which would garble the link to the MCU board
alternatives.via: UART0 on header pins 8 (GPIO14 TX) and 10 (GPIO15 RX)
